mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.dept_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.email, u.phone, u.gender, u.avatar, u.status, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.login_count, u.login_fail_count, u.pwd_reset_time, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.update_by, u.update_time, u.del_flag, u.remark FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id WHERE ur.role_id = #{roleId} AND u.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY u.create_time DESC
